common_guards.rule: Only the trusted Demo Evaluation Harness may issue the verdict; Consumer self-report, capability return values, and command receipts are not outcome evidence.
Forbidden collision, joint-limit violation, emergency stop, fixture overturning, or a target object leaving the admitted workspace fails the trial.
A NaN, infinity, missing required physical measurement, or unavailable required observation fails the trial.

definitions.released: The gripper no longer supports the object.
definitions.held: The gripper continues to support the object according to trusted contact and relative-pose evidence.
definitions.settled: The task-specific frozen linear- and angular-velocity limits hold for the stated continuous dwell.
definitions.task_instance_parameters: Targets, regions, object identities, timeouts, reset distribution, and scene-specific safety limits are frozen in the executable task instance before a trial.

criteria.criterion_text: Tip-position error is at most 20 mm and tip speed is at most 10 mm/s continuously for 0.5 s.
Intended tip-face contact persists for at least 0.3 s; object displacement is at most 10 mm; no other object is contacted.
Cube-center planar error is at most 25 mm, the cube remains supported by the table, and cube linear speed is at most 0.010 m/s and angular speed is at most 0.10 rad/s continuously for 1.0 s.
Cylinder center is within 25 mm of the goal; symmetry-axis tilt is at most 0.20 rad; the cylinder remains supported and settled for 1 s.
Ball center remains within a 40 mm goal radius and its speed is at most 20 mm/s for 1 s.
Yaw error is at most 10 degrees, center displacement from the allowed local region is at most 30 mm, and the block is settled for 1 s.
Top-view geometric overlap between the block and target silhouette is at least 90%; the block remains settled for 1 s.
The cube rises by at least 20 mm; gripper-relative slip is at most 5 mm over 1 s; the cube remains held.
Cube-center height increases by at least 80 mm, the cube has no table contact, and it remains held for 1 s.
Cube-center distance to the goal is at most 25 mm; the cube remains grasped and settled for 1 s.
At least 90% of the cube footprint is inside the target; the cube is supported, released, and settled for 1 s.
The entire projected cube footprint is inside the tray's inner boundary; the cube is tray-supported, released, and settled for 1 s.
The sphere satisfies the bin's geometric containment relation, is bin-supported and released, and remains below the allowed speed for 1 s.
Cylinder center is within 20 mm of the target; axis tilt is at most 0.20 rad; the cylinder is supported, released, and settled for 1 s.
The top cube is supported by the base cube; XY offset is at most 25% of cube width; both cubes are released and settled for 1 s.
Peg axis is within 0.10 rad of vertical; the peg base is table-supported; the peg is released and stable for 1 s.
The correct peg passes through the ring; ring bottom is at most 5 mm from its stop surface; tilt is at most 10 degrees; the ring is released and stable.
Insertion depth is at least 50% of the declared insertable segment; axis error is at most 10 degrees; fixture displacement is at most 5 mm; the state persists for 1 s.
The correct shape is fully seated in the correct slot, with its top at or below the allowed entrance height; the shape is released and stable.
Specified button displacement is at least 3 mm and activation persists for at least 0.25 s; no other button is activated.
Drawer joint reaches at least 80% of its declared open range; cabinet displacement is at most 10 mm; the drawer remains settled for 1 s.
Drawer joint is at most 5% of its open range and remains settled for 1 s; the cabinet stays within its fixture tolerance.
Door joint reaches at least 80% of its declared open range and remains settled for 1 s; fixture displacement is at most 10 mm.
The lid enters the declared off-container goal region; its lowest point clears the rim by at least 30 mm; container displacement is at most 10 mm; the condition persists for at least 0.5 s.
Each object is fully contained in its assigned tray; both are released and settled for 1 s. A swapped assignment fails.
The Harness event log records a persistent successful placement of A before B; the final state contains both objects, released and settled.
The object is contained in the drawer volume; drawer joint is at most 5% open; the object is released and the final state remains stable for 1 s.
The cube enters the goal region; Harness contact history shows tool-mediated cube displacement; direct gripper-cube contact before goal entry causes failure; the cube settles for 1 s.
